# SHA-256 checksums of vendored, self-hosted third-party assets (§A.6 supply-chain integrity).
# The strict CSP forbids any CDN, so every third-party asset is vendored; this file pins their
# exact bytes. A test (tests/test_supply_chain.py) and a CI job fail if any of them ever changes
# without this pin being updated deliberately.
#
# **Every file in this directory that is not a licence or this file itself must be listed here.**
# That is asserted by tests/test_supply_chain.py::test_every_vendored_asset_is_pinned_by_name —
# without it, dropping a new asset in with no pin would be invisible to the checksum loop, which
# only ever verifies what this file already names (v0.13.0).
#
# Regenerate intentionally with:
#   cd src/netcorenoc/ui/vendor && sha256sum d3.v7.min.js preact-10.29.8.module.js htm-3.1.1.module.js
#
# ## Provenance
#
# Each asset's bytes are the corresponding file from the upstream npm tarball, unmodified. The
# tarballs themselves were verified against the registry's own published `dist.shasum` before any
# file was extracted, so the chain is registry -> tarball -> file -> the pin below.
#
#   d3.v7.min.js              d3 v7.9.0, ISC
#   preact-10.29.8.module.js  preact 10.29.8, MIT, npm tarball dist/preact.module.js
#                             tarball sha1 fc85b82dc2474e245b1430b51781d417361f5fc3
#   htm-3.1.1.module.js       htm 3.1.1, Apache-2.0, npm tarball dist/htm.module.js
#                             tarball sha1 49266582be0dc66ed2235d5ea892307cc0c24b78
#
# Both ESM modules are **import-free**: neither carries a bare specifier, so the UI loads them by
# relative path with no import map. That is load-bearing — an import map is an inline
# <script type="importmap">, which the CSP forbids (see docs/adr/DECISIONS.md #175).
f2094bbf6141b359722c4fe454eb6c4b0f0e42cc10cc7af921fc158fceb86539  d3.v7.min.js
c30e721ebfdc6e2ad4c18c14d2dfb82667829c8aec27de1207774e3fc16858a8  preact-10.29.8.module.js
ab33dd3f38059b9be4d5f5350128eefb2356639c4e0bbe9d9e8b3ba75847e9e4  htm-3.1.1.module.js
